rows.category: SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female / Transgender / Minorities / EBC

content_sections.heading: Selection Process - CBT Pattern
content_sections.text: Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for PwBD candidates eligible for scribe assistance). Objective, multiple-choice, single-stage CBT; negative marking of 1/3 mark per wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks: UR/EWS 40%, OBC-NCL & SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by 2 marks for PwBD where vacancies remain unfilled). Candidates equal to the number of vacancies (RRB-wise, 1:1) are called for Document Verification based on CBT merit. DV is followed by a Medical Examination as per the post's medical standard (B1/C1/C2); medically unfit candidates get no alternative post. Final empanelment is based on CBT merit, subject to DV and medical fitness; selection does not itself confer a right to appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Visit the unified RRB website rrb.indianrailways.gov.in and navigate to the CEN 05/2026 application link. Create an Account (or use existing RRB login credentials from earlier CENs) with a valid personal mobile number and email ID - these cannot be changed later. Authenticate identity via DigiLocker/Aadhaar for smoother verification at later stages (recommended). Choose only one RRB and give your order of preference for posts/Railway Zones within that RRB. Capture a live photograph via webcam/phone camera as instructed (no pre-existing photo uploads allowed). Upload your signature (JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB) and, if claiming SC/ST free travel, the SC/ST certificate (PDF, under 400 KB). Choose your CBT medium of examination (English, Hindi, or one of 13 regional languages). Pay the examination fee online (net banking/card/UPI) to complete submission. Use the modification window (17–26 October 2026, ₹250 fee) if corrections are needed - except to Create-an-Account details or chosen RRB. Important: Multiple applications to different RRBs, or more than one application to the same RRB, will lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from all future RRB/RRC examinations.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (at Document Verification)
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th certificate (for name and date of birth proof) Educational/technical/professional qualification certificates as per the post applied for Caste/community certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS), in the prescribed Annexure format, where reservation is claimed EBC/Minority community certificate, where fee concession is claimed PwBD disability certificate (Form V/VI) and UDID, where applicable Ex-Servicemen discharge/employment certificate, where applicable Aadhaar card (for identity and fee refund linkage) NOC from present employer, for candidates already in Government/PSU service Two sets of self-attested photocopies of all original documents

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil depending on the Railway Administration's requirements. Candidates waiting for final results of the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible to apply. Free Sleeper Class train travel is admissible only to SC/ST candidates (if opted) for CBT/DV/Medical Examination stages. Selected candidates are ordinarily posted to the Railway/Zone of first appointment; transfer requests are not entertained until 5–10 years of service. Selection by RRB does not confer any right to appointment - the RRB only recommends candidates; the Zonal Railway issues the actual offer. Any use of unfair means, impersonation, or false information leads to lifetime debarment from all RRB/RRC examinations and possible legal action. Banned items (mobile phones, calculators, watches, etc.) are not allowed inside the examination centre; only the e-call letter is permitted.

faq.question: Q1. What is RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: It is a Centralised Employment Notification issued by the Railway Recruitment Boards for the recruitment of various Paramedical categories, covering 9 posts and 590 vacancies across all RRB zones.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: There are 590 total vacancies: Nursing Superintendent (365), Pharmacist Entry Grade (118), Health & Malaria Inspector Gr II (43), Radiographer X-Ray Technician (25), Lab Assistant Gr. II (31), ECG Technician (4), Optometrist (2), Dialysis Technician (1), and Audiologist & Speech Therapist (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for online application submission is 14.10.2026 (23:59 hrs); the last date for fee payment is 16.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RRB CEN 05/2026 posts?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post, ranging from 18–33 years to 20–40 years as on 01.01.2027, with relaxations up to 15 years for PwBD-SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for general candidates (₹400 refundable) and ₹250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Female/Transgender/Minorities/EBC candidates (fully refundable), on appearing in the CBT.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for RRB CEN 05/2026 posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from 12th pass with a paramedical diploma (Lab Assistant, ECG Technician) to a Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Pharmacy, Audiology, or Optometry, along with relevant registration where required. Full post-wise details are in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Single Stage Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 questions/100 marks with negative marking, followed by Document Verification and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for RRB Paramedical posts under CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: Initial pay ranges from ₹21,700 (Lab Assistant Gr. II, Level 3) to ₹44,900 (Nursing Superintendent, Level 7), as per the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must create an account on the unified RRB website (rrb.indianrailways.gov.in), select one RRB, fill the application with post/zone preferences, capture a live photo, upload documents, pay the fee, and submit before 14.10.2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the RRB CEN 05/2026 CBT?
faq.answer: Yes, there is negative marking of 1/3 mark deducted for every wrong answer in the CBT.
